scope: Resolved grouping decisions only; not the complete family inventory or Item 8 acceptance

groups.name: YUNG's Better Mineshafts
groups.rationale: These are biome, material, decoration and support variants of the same specialized mineshaft network generator. All share BetterMineshaftStructure and BetterMineshaftGenerator. Their structure definitions differ only in biome constraints and BetterMineshaftConfiguration. Rooms, intersections, ore deposits, tunnels and entrance pieces are generated components, not additional families. This decision does not imply that arbitrary structures sharing a generic jigsaw codec belong to one family.

distinctions.minecraft:mineshaft: Separate vanilla generator, registered but suppressed by the frozen Better Mineshafts hook
distinctions.minecraft:mineshaft_mesa: Variant of the separate vanilla generator, registered but suppressed by the frozen Better Mineshafts hook

intended_hostility.value: Hostile rooms within an abandoned mining network
intended_hostility.basis: Derived from explicit hostile-entity spawner assignment in SideRoomDungeon and ZombieVillagerRoom, not from structure naming or measured encounter frequency.

mob_source.authored_source: Custom piece-generation code assigns ordinary block spawners to EntityType.CAVE_SPIDER and EntityType.ZOMBIE_VILLAGER.
mob_source.natural_source: The structure definitions have empty spawn_overrides. Ambient hostile populations depend on effective biome spawning and world conditions; their exact composition is UNKNOWN here.
mob_source.scope: Possible generation paths, not a claim that every mineshaft includes both rooms.

loot_table_source.basis: Direct references in the preserved generation disassemblies. SmallTunnel and BigTunnel include chest-minecart paths.
loot_table_source.effective_injections: UNKNOWN: retained loot-integration and container transformation effects still require attribution.

generated_spawners.basis: The piece code places Blocks.SPAWNER, checks SpawnerBlockEntity, then calls setEntityId.
generated_spawners.limitation: Source-supported capability; room selection, successful placement and active spawning are not established for every generated sample.

authored_or_natural_enemies.authored: Cave-spider and zombie-villager spawner assignments are authored by custom generation code.
authored_or_natural_enemies.natural: No structure-level spawn override is declared; natural spawning remains conditional on the effective biome and world state.
authored_or_natural_enemies.limitation: This does not measure enemy counts or prove a particular live spawn.

underground_surface_classification.value: Underground mining network with a VerticalEntrance generation component
underground_surface_classification.basis: Packaged step is underground_structures. BetterMineshaftStructure selects initial Y from the frozen -55 through 30 range and begins generation with VerticalEntrance.
underground_surface_classification.limitation: Initial Y is not total vertical size. The entrance envelope uses maximum build height and does not prove occupied blocks or a visible surface opening.

groups.name: WDA Seven Seas Corsair Corvette
groups.rationale: An independently registered named vessel design with its own main hull template and start pool. Its subordinate spawner pools and templates are components of this vessel, not additional families. The five named vessel designs use separate hull resources; no registry aliases or expansion-size variants are counted separately here.

intended_hostility.basis: Authored hostile-entity spawner templates in the linked vessel pool, rather than natural spawning alone.
intended_hostility.limitation: This does not establish placement success or encountered enemy counts.

approximate_footprint.basis: Packaged main hull template extent before rotation. Reachable subordinate templates are spawner components.
approximate_footprint.assembled_occupied_footprint: UNKNOWN: not measured in a generated world; this extent can include air.

approximate_vertical_size.basis: Packaged main hull template height, including stored air.

mob_source.basis: Entity IDs in SpawnData and positive-weight SpawnPotentials of the reachable, available spawner templates.
mob_source.natural_spawning: No structure spawn override is declared. Effective natural populations and environmental survival remain conditional.
mob_source.limitation: These are base entity types, not a count of encountered enemies. Bats are ambient entities, and the full authored NBT can modify other entities.

loot_table_source.basis: LootTable references in the main hull block-entity NBT.
loot_table_source.effective_injections: UNKNOWN: loot integration and runtime container transformations remain to be attributed.

generated_spawners.basis: Available subordinate templates contain ordinary spawner block NBT. Pool alternatives remain distinct from observed counts.

authored_or_natural_enemies.authored: The vessel supplies configured spawner components; hostility is not solely the result of natural biome spawning.
authored_or_natural_enemies.natural: Empty spawn_overrides leave natural spawning conditional on the effective biome and world state.

underground_surface_classification.basis: Ocean biome constraints and WORLD_SURFACE_WG heightmap projection in a surface_structures definition.
underground_surface_classification.limitation: The offset locates the start, not every hull block; submerged extent and surface visibility remain unmeasured.

groups.name: Integrated Stronghold
groups.rationale: One assembled stronghold rooted at the fountain start pool. Dining halls, libraries, prisons, portal rooms and other connected pools are components of this structure, not independent families. Vanilla and Better Strongholds remain separate generator identities; their effective replacement relationships require disposition.

mob_source.basis: Packaged structure definition. This is a natural monster-spawn override within piece bounds, not an authored spawn count.
mob_source.authored_content: Reachable template entities, spawners and processors remain to be attributed.

underground_surface_classification.value: Underground start with assembled surface exposure unresolved
underground_surface_classification.basis: Packaged start_height is a uniform distribution with both absolute endpoints at Y=15 and generation step strongholds. The custom generator and terrain determine the final occupied extent.
